descriptionHtml: The Power System Simulation Workshop is a two-day webinar series. This webinar centers on the utilization of the OpenDSS platform and offers comprehensive guidance on its operation. It serves as a valuable opportunity to bolster the professional competence of participants, with a particular emphasis on undergraduate students preparing for future roles in the industry.
